in_hebrew.name: Filomeno
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Friend of God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Filomeno הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Filomeno is derived from the Latin words filus (son) and amicus (friend). It can be translated as 'friend of God'. This name was popular among early Christians and is a reminder of the spiritual bond between God and His children.

in_greek.name: Φιλόμενος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek words 'philos' (love) and 'meno' (stay, remain). Thus, Filomeno means 'the one who is beloved and remains'.

in_latin.name: Filomenus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin words 'filus' (son) and 'amare' (to love). Thus, Filomenus means 'beloved son'.
